documents_open_draft.name: documents_open_draft
documents_open_draft.where: "documents"."frozen_at" is null and "documents"."version_group_id" is not null

documents_pdf_pending.name: documents_pdf_pending
documents_pdf_pending.where: "documents"."frozen_at" is not null and "documents"."pdf_sha256" is null and "documents"."type" in ('proposal', 'estimate', 'tax_invoice', 'export_invoice', 'proforma', 'credit_note', 'debit_note')

documents_numbered_when_frozen.name: documents_numbered_when_frozen
documents_numbered_when_frozen.value: ("documents"."frozen_at" is null and "documents"."number" is null) or ("documents"."frozen_at" is not null and "documents"."number" is not null and "documents"."number_display" is not null)

statement_pdfs_range.name: statement_pdfs_range
statement_pdfs_range.value: date("statement_pdfs"."from_date") is "statement_pdfs"."from_date" and date("statement_pdfs"."to_date") is "statement_pdfs"."to_date" and "statement_pdfs"."from_date" <= "statement_pdfs"."to_date"
